newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: OLYMPICS-ROME'S BID SHINES, POLLUTION MARS ATHENS.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-ROME'S BID SHINES, POLLUTION MARS ATHENS.

text.p: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) issued its evaluation report on Thursday on 11 candidate cities bidding to host the 2004 Olympics.
They are Athens, Buenos Aires, Cape Town, Istanbul, Lille, Rio de Janeiro, Rome, San Juan, Seville, Stockholm and St Petersburg. The winner will be named on September 5.

The following is a brief outline of the IOC's assessments on the main strengths and weaknesses of the candidate cities, in alphabetical order, on issues including the state of venues, facilities, accomodation, security, transport and environment.
*** ATHENS ***
STRENGTHS:
LOCAL SUPPORT - Excellent with 96.4 percent support.
VENUES - Good conditions for most venues.
FACILITIES - High-quality. Village 30 minutes from city
ACCOMODATION - Four-five star 6,076 rooms and cruise ships
WEAKNESSES:
ENVIRONMENT - Possibility of high pollution due to high temperatures during the period of the Games
TRANSPORT - Significant airport access problems.
BUDGET - Doubts over the $285 million in revenues budgeted.
*** BUENOS AIRES ***
STRENGTHS:
LOCAL SUPPORT - 86.8 percent aware of which 70.8 in favour.
VENUES - Good conditions for tennis, judo, artistic gymnastics, triathlon and yachting. Also good football stadiums.
FACILITIES - Convenient and environmentally-friendly.
ENVIRONMENT - Realistic programme.
WEAKNESSES:
ACCOMODATION - Up to 50-70 percent capacity expansion needed
TRANSPORT - International airport needs major improvement.
BUDGET - Appears conservative.
VENUES - Technical challenges for rowing and canoeing. Mountain biking venue more than four hours away from the city.
WEATHER - Possibility of rain, temperatures of 10 degrees Celsius
*** CAPE TOWN ***
STRENGTHS:
LOCAL SUPPORT - The committee says the Games will help unite South Africans in post-Apartheid transition. Full government support although local poll results inconclusive.
VENUES - Some sites will help development. 75,000-seat Olympic Stadium to be built. Good conditions for most venues.
FACILITIES - Generally good revised plans.
WEAKNESSES:
ENVIRONMENT - Preliminary environmental studies needed.
SECURITY - Serious crime situation is a challenge
TRANSPORT - Good basic infrastructure but many improvements needed, particularly for the airport and railways.
CAPACITY - A 45 percent growth in hotel capacity foreseen. 5,000 existing and planned four-five star hotel rooms.
BUDGET - Sponsorship and ticket sales revenues on high side.
LEGISLATION - New pieces of legislation needed.
*** ISTANBUL ***
STRENGTHS:
LOCAL SUPPORT - Up to 96.2 percent according to a city poll.
ACCOMODATION - Sufficient with 11,000 existing four-five star hotel rooms plus 6,000 more under construction or planned.
WEAKNESSES:
VENUES - Plans for some sites need development. Road access to tennis, archery and equestrian events need improvement.
FACILITIES - Olympic Village plans need to be elaborated.
ENVIRONMENT - Environmental programme will depend on a financial plan and sufficient political endorsement.
TRANSPORT - Inadequate airport. Serious transport problems. Determination for improvement but detailed planning needed.
BUDGET - Financial plans appear conservative.
*** LILLE ***
STRENGTHS:
LOCAL SUPPORT - Strong, up to 86 percent.
VENUES - Good for basketball, fencing, hockey, yachting.
ENVIRONMENT - An enviable programme targetting all areas.
BUDGET - Financially sound.
WEAKNESSES:
FACILITIES - Plan to construct the Olympic Village, in a densely-populated area less than 10 km from city centre, is a challenge. Will be difficult to provide quiet living conditions.
ACCOMODATION - A real challenge because many of existing and planned sites are 60 minutes from city centre.
TRANSPORT - Connection flights needed via Brussels, Paris or London. Transport a challenge due to need for buses and cars. The old city's narrow streets problematic for shuttle buses.
WEATHER - Wind conditions may have negative effect on rowing, canoeing, archery and shooting.
LEGISLATION - Customs formalities need clarification.
*** RIO DE JANEIRO ***
STRENGTHS:
LOCAL SUPPORT - Enthusiastic, with 84 percent support.
VENUES - Good for most venues.
FACILITIES - Favourable plans for Village construction.
ACCOMODATION - Sufficient with 7,300 out of 12,000 existing four-five star hotel rooms being offered.
WEAKNESSES:
ENVIRONMENT - Huge challenges for water supply, waste management, sanitation and sewage treatment.
SECURITY - Crime situation difficult despite recent progress
TRANSPORT - Significant problems.
BUDGET - Estimates for capital investment seem low.
*** ROME ***
STRENGTHS:
LOCAL SUPPORT - Latest poll shows 81 percent of the population support the bid and 97 percent aware of it.
VENUES - Excellent and professional plans. Some sites in historic locations. Good conditions foreseen for most venues.
FACILITIES - High quality village plan.
ENVIRONMENT - Wide support for the environmental plan.
ACCOMODATION - Excellent with 6,800 rooms out of 15,440 existing four-five star rooms offered.
BUDGET - Thorough and detailed. Revenues appear high.
WEAKNESSES:
TRANSPORT - Traffic major problem but improvements planned
*** SAN JUAN ***
STRENGTHS:
LOCAL SUPPORT - Up to 94 percent
VENUES - Excellent venue for yachting
ACCOMODATION - 5,585 and 1,288 planned four-five star hotel rooms. Creative accomodation plan.
WEAKNESSES:
POLITICAL GUARANTEES - The city needs various guarantees from relevant U.S. authorities regarding Olympic requirements
VENUES - Further studies still required for accomodation, transport. Technical challenges for football.
FACILITIES - Existing plans could be improved.
ENVIRONMENT - Accurate information lacking.
WEATHER - Possibility of high temperatures and humidity.
TRANSPORT - Good infrastructure but many major improvements needed although proposals would be sufficient when completed.
BUDGET - A $300 million credit line needed.
*** SEVILLE ***
LOCAL SUPPORT - Very strong with up to 92.3 percent polled.
VENUES - Excellent potential if developed. Good conditions
FACILITIES - Olympic Village plans meet needs in general.
ENVIRONMENT - Key issues addressed but impact studies needed
WEAKNESSES:
ACCOMODATION - 4,762 out of 4,879 existing four-five star hotel rooms offered but plans need clarification.
TRANSPORT - Excellent infrastructure but complex challenges
WEATHER - Warm and sunny days foreseen, but also possibility of high temperatures.
BUDGET - Reasonable but reservations over relatively low construction costs. Serious concerns over local sponsorship
LEGISLATION - Customs formalities need clarification
*** STOCKHOLM ***
STRENGTHS:
VENUES - Good conditions for most venues
ENVIRONMENT - Tied into the city's environmental plans
ACCOMODATION - Fully met by regoin's vast network of 107,916 existing and 8,600 future planned rooms
TRANSPORT - Reliable and extensive public transport
HEALTH - Excellent and well-staffed facilities. Advanced anti-doping programme
TELECOMMUNICATIONS - High technological standards
BUDGET - Transparent. Financial guarantees are high quality.
WEAKNESSES:
LOCAL SUPPORT - 52 percent of population oppose the bid on ecological and environmental concerns.
*** ST PETERSBURG ***
LOCAL SUPPORT - Some 74.2 percent according to surveys.
VENUES - Good conditions for most indoors venues. Adequate plans for the construction of the Olympic Village.
WEAKNESSES:
ENVIRONMENT - Environment plan evaluation not possible yet
ACCOMODATION - Only 7,000 three to five star hotel rooms exist out of 21,000 needed for the Olympic Family.
TRANSPORT - Major improvements needed
BUDGET - Totals $9.6 billion and raises serious concerns
